hub.title: Settings
hub.subtitle: Company information, rules, system settings and data transfer.

access.title: Access settings
access.subtitle: Decide what employees can see on their home page, in their account and in the calendar.
access.scopeNotice: Access settings only restrict users with the Employee access type; Account owners, Administrators and HR users are not affected. Changes take effect as soon as they are saved.
access.readOnly: You can view access settings but are not allowed to change them.
access.loadError: Access settings could not be loaded.
access.saveError: Access settings could not be saved.

showOrgInfo.label: Employee and unit information
showOrgInfo.help: Information about units (unit, manager, team) is visible to employees on the home page.

showUpcomingLeaves.label: Upcoming leave
showUpcomingLeaves.help: People who will be on leave are listed on the home page. The leave type is not shown.

showUpcomingBirthdays.label: Upcoming birthdays
showUpcomingBirthdays.help: Employees see their colleagues' upcoming birthdays on the home page.

showEventCalendar.label: Event calendar
showEventCalendar.help: Meetings and similar events added in the app are listed on the home page.

showFiles.label: Files
showFiles.help: Employees can see the files on their own profile.

showAssets.label: Assets
showAssets.help: Employees can see the assets assigned to them.

showWorkPhoneNumbers.label: Employees' phone numbers
showWorkPhoneNumbers.help: If a work phone is set, it is visible to other employees.

showOrgChart.label: Org chart
showOrgChart.help: The org chart under Employees is opened to employees.

showCustomFields.label: Custom fields
showCustomFields.help: Unit authorized users can see custom fields on employee profiles. Employees cannot.

showCalendarMenu.label: Calendar menu
showCalendarMenu.help: Calendar is shown in the left menu.

showAllLeavesInCalendar.label: All leave in the calendar
showAllLeavesInCalendar.help: When off, employees only see leave in their own department; when on, they see leave across the whole company. Only "on leave" is shown, never the leave type.

supportAccess.title: Support access
supportAccess.subtitle: Approve or revoke requests from the Sense support team to access your company account.
supportAccess.privacyTitle: Your data stays under your control
supportAccess.privacyText: Sense staff cannot access your company's data without a time-limited access grant that you approve. An approved grant closes automatically when it expires, can be revoked at any time, and every action is recorded in the audit log.
supportAccess.approveConfirm: Approve time-limited support access for {{requester}}? Access stays valid until it expires or you revoke it.
supportAccess.revokeConfirm: Revoke this support access? Any ongoing session will be closed.
supportAccess.actionError: The action could not be completed.
supportAccess.loadError: Support access requests could not be loaded.

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.subtitle: Manage the custom field definitions shown on employee cards.

fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter. Cannot be changed after creation.
fields.keyImmutable: The key cannot be changed after creation.
fields.keyInvalid: The key must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
fields.name: Name
fields.dataTypeImmutable: The data type cannot be changed after creation.
fields.optionsHint: Type a value and press Enter to add an option.
fields.optionsRequired: Select-type fields require at least one option.
fields.isEmployeeEditable: Employee can edit from their own card
fields.isEmployeeEditableHint: When on, the employee may edit this field from their own card (self-service).
fields.employeeEditRequiresApprovalHint: For now the change is applied directly; an approval flow will be added in a later package.
fields.isSensitiveHint: Only callers with 'View sensitive fields' can see/change the value.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: Custom field definitions could not be loaded.
errors.keyTaken: This key is already used by another custom field definition.
